changes: A HungerStation cart may hold up to four meals with options, each with a different name and quantity one.
Each meal's options are read from its own HungerStation edit page in order, and the cart is proven unchanged after each page closes.
Keeta adds the meals one at a time and, after each add, verifies the cart holds exactly the meals added so far; the journal settles each add before the next.
Review of several configured meals in Keeta goes through the verified cart drawer, like a single meal.
The Octopus start hint names the new limit.
limitations: Not yet run on a phone; this release is for the user's own phone trial.
Not supported: a plain item in the same cart as a meal with options, two meals with the same name, quantity above one, a Keeta cart that already holds only some of the meals, and optional additions.
If the Keeta cart drawer scrolls with three or four meals, the comparison stops with a message; this has not been tried.
Verified on KFC only in earlier releases; other restaurants are not proven.
privacy: No account data, addresses, tokens, private captures or signing material included.
